name: Gmail
description: Your Gmail in lanes (Unread, Alerts, Read), Grafana alerts grouped, sorted by Jev triage, a thread opened as a clean page to discuss with Claude, Jira mail with its issue (with bronos.jira), mark read / unread. It only ever changes the read state: it never archives, labels, trashes or sends.
author: Oleg Bronzov

clientId.title: OAuth client ID
clientId.description: The client ID of your own Google Cloud OAuth client (a Desktop app client), ending in .apps.googleusercontent.com. Or leave it empty and paste the client file in the Gmail panel: a pasted client wins. Changing it signs you out.

clientSecret.title: OAuth client secret
clientSecret.description: The client secret of the same Desktop app client (Google Cloud console > Google Auth Platform > Clients).

lanes.title: Lanes
lanes.description: Which lanes to show. A hidden lane is not fetched and never sent to triage. Alerts shows only with alert senders.

read.title: Read (the inbox of the last days)

rowsPerLane.title: Threads per lane
rowsPerLane.description: How many threads a lane shows; the rest are behind Show all at the bottom of the lane.

unreadDays.title: Unread: days back
unreadDays.description: How far back the Unread and Alerts lanes look.

maxUnread.title: Unread: threads fetched
maxUnread.description: The newest unread threads read from Gmail (alerts are listed apart and do not count).

readDays.title: Read: days back
readDays.description: How far back the Read lane looks in the inbox.

maxRead.title: Read: threads fetched
maxRead.description: The newest read inbox threads shown (alerts left out).

alertSenders.title: Alert senders
alertSenders.description: Addresses whose mail goes to the Alerts lane (Grafana alerts are grouped by alert name). Empty: no Alerts lane.

pollMinutes.title: Poll every (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: Only while this project's window is open. A poll first asks Gmail whether anything changed, which costs almost nothing.

markReadOnOpen.title: Opening a thread marks it read
markReadOnOpen.description: Opening a thread from the panel marks it read in Gmail, as Gmail does (an alert row: the threads it shows). Off: it stays unread until you press Mark read.

triageText.title: What triage reads
triageText.description: Full: sender, recipients, subject and the snippets of the thread go to Jev (through Jev triage). Summary: only sender and subject, for employers who object to mail text leaving.

cli.name: gmail
cli.summary: Gmail: status, refresh, list the lanes, show a thread, mark it read or unread, sign in or out, set the OAuth client
cli.usage: gmail status | refresh | list [lane] | show <threadId> | read <threadId> | unread <threadId> | login | logout | client <file.json> | help
